auditMetadata.workstream: Workstream A (Phase 1: Architecture Audit & Phase 9: Test Coverage Audit)

findings: Local/cn `pages` branch still holds V4.5.0 ("World Travel Globe · 全球旅行地理图鉴", SW cache wtg-shell-mwyz1yax / wtg-data-v4), NOT V5.0.0 (KAIROS).

Meanwhile .github/workflows/deploy-pages.yml builds ./dist directly from `main` via actions/deploy-pages@v4 (artifact upload), leaving scripts/sync-pages-branch.js and the orphan `pages` branch stale.

ciWorkflows: .github/workflows/ci-quality.yml (runs audit, build, test, playwright-core E2E on main push/PR)

godObjectsAndComplexity.evidence: 3,899 LOC (145,823 bytes), 255 inner functions; `bindEvents` is 735 lines (L2419-3153, nesting 8); `starfield` IIFE is 446 lines (L260-705, nesting 6); `buildStyle` is 254 lines (L825-1078). Single monolithic coordinator tightly coupled to 25+ globals and 100+ DOM IDs.

1,495 LOC (82,484 bytes), 76 inner functions; `renderWorkspace` / `tripToCsv` complex block ~655 lines. Combines routing, multi-city planning, budget FX, prep checklist, drag-drop DOM rendering, CSV/URL serialization, and lazy loaders in one file.
1,291 LOC (70,229 bytes); `mount()` is 524 lines (nesting 7), mixing SunCalc/Astronomy math, POI scoring, DEM horizon raytracing callbacks, Weather fetch, and large inline HTML templates.
`handleApi` in worker/index.js is 506 lines (L65-570); `handleAuthRequest` in worker/auth.js is 453 lines (L215-667). Long sequential `if (p === ...)` route chains without router abstraction.

overlappingAndDuplicateModules.relationship: Complementary (not strict duplicate), but misleading naming: `gallery.js` (`AestheticGallery`) renders the 722-destination catalog grid view and delegates thumbnail fetching to `media-gallery.js` (`MediaGallery`), which handles Wikimedia Commons photos, EXIF season tabs, Wikidata badge, and lightbox.

Overlapping & broken integration: `ShareCenter` calls `PosterShare.renderPosterCanvas` passing `bullets: [...]` (js/lazy/share-center.js:200), which `PosterShare.renderPosterCanvas` completely ignores (js/modules/poster-share.js:234,262 only reads `metrics`, `bars`, `lines`). Also `PosterShare.openPosterModal` still embeds a secondary button to open `ShareCenter`, splitting share UX across two modals.

Both search libraries are eagerly bundled in `vendor/libs.bundle.min.js` (and `index.html`:663,667) AND `fuse.min.js` is additionally copied standalone for `atlas-worker.js`. `command-palette.js` uses both `GeoIntelligence` (MiniSearch) and `Fuse` fallback.

Both astronomical libraries are eagerly bundled in `vendor/libs.bundle.min.js`: `SunCalc` handles solar/lunar positions & golden hour (`photo-simulator.js`, `aesthetic-index.js`, `phenology-engine.js`, `earth-timemachine.js`), while `Astronomy Engine` is used for Galactic Center (Sgr A*), `-18°` astronomical twilight, and `solar-terminator.js`.

Overlapping audio engines: `bgm.js` eagerly constructs `new Audio("assets/prologue/the-blue-horizon.mp3?v=1")` with `preload="auto"` at top level (L4-7) even when intro is skipped; `ambient-radio.js` lists the same file as Track 00 (`the-blue-horizon`) with `preload="none"` and manually stops `CosmicBGM` when played.

Duplicate terminator implementation: `earth-timemachine.js` still retains a legacy approximate solar declination polygon generator (L114-138) using `tan(declRad)` and `nightPole` clamping, despite `solar-terminator.js` having been rewritten in V4.5 with true subsolar spherical cap geometry + antimeridian clipping.

deadOrBrokenWiring.area: CollabSpace UI vs Backend D1 & BroadcastChannel
deadOrBrokenWiring.finding: When signed in (`useCloud === true`), CollabSpace displays "Connected to D1 RBAC Server Sync" (L85-88), yet NEVER sends any HTTP request to `/api/collab/*`! Every mutation (invites, revoke, roles, polls, votes, comments, expenses) writes only to localStorage (`wtg_collab_spaces_v1`). Furthermore, L37 posts to `BroadcastChannel("kairos_collab")`, but zero files in the codebase listen (`onmessage` / `addEventListener`) to `kairos_collab`, making cross-tab sync completely one-way/dead.

`ShareCenter.buildDeepLink` advertises "Deep Link (Restores spot, azimuth, date & locale)" and emits `?focus=&spot=&cam=&date=&layers=&lang=`. `readInitialUrlState()` in `js/app.js` parses `camBearing`, `dateStr`, and `layers` into `initialParams`, but NONE of `initialParams.camBearing`, `initialParams.dateStr`, or `initialParams.layers` are ever consumed anywhere in `js/app.js`.

deadOrBrokenWiring.area: ShareCenter QR Size, Type Selector & Poster Bullets
deadOrBrokenWiring.finding: (1) Calls `QRCodeService.renderSvg(shareUrl, 136)` passing a number, whereas `QRCodeService.renderSvg(text, opts)` (`js/services/qr-code.js:210`) expects `opts.size`, causing silent fallback to 180px. (2) `#sc-type-sel` has no `change` event listener, so switching the 12 share types in the UI does not update the link, title, or QR. (3) Passes `bullets` to `PosterShare.renderPosterCanvas`, which only renders `metrics`/`bars`/`lines`.

deadOrBrokenWiring.area: Service Worker Cache Partition & Fallback Bugs
deadOrBrokenWiring.finding: (1) `build-dist.js` places `./vendor/libs.bundle.min.js?v=${buildVer}` and `./vendor/maplibre-gl.js` into `CORE_ASSETS` (`CACHE_NAME`), yet `sw.js` fetch handler intercepts `/vendor/` FIRST (L60) using `DATA_CACHE = "kairos-data-v5"` (unversioned). Thus precached vendor bundles in `CACHE_NAME` are bypassed on first fetch, duplicated in `DATA_CACHE`, and old versioned `libs.bundle.min.js?v=*` are never evicted on `activate`. (2) `sw.js:121` returns `hit || (await netPromise)` where `netPromise` resolves to `null` on offline error — resolving `respondWith(null)` causes a browser SW TypeError instead of a valid Response. (3) `manifest.webmanifest`, `assets/skyboxes/*`, and `data/enrichment/atlas-enrichment.json` are not precached or matched in `DATA_CACHE`.

deadOrBrokenWiring.area: Duplicate Brand Source PNGs & Unused Preview Image
deadOrBrokenWiring.finding: `assets/brand/source/` stores 18 PNGs (~20 MB total): the 9 `ChatGPT 图像 2026年11月28日 *.png` files are byte-for-byte identical duplicates of the 9 `kairos-*.png` files. Also `assets/brand/social/preview-primary.png` is copied into `dist/` but not referenced in HTML/JS or `BRAND_GUIDELINES.md`.

deadOrBrokenWiring.area: Unreferenced Global & HTML IDs / Escape Key Gaps
deadOrBrokenWiring.finding: (1) `window.AppSkybox` (`js/app.js:707`) has 0 external consumers. (2) HTML IDs `#loader-text` (L70), `#layer-meta-inspector` (L431), and `#layer-meta-legend` (L437) are never referenced in JS or CSS. (3) Global `Escape` handler (`js/app.js:3081`) does not close `#music-popover`, `#account-modal`, `#share-center-modal`, `#help-center-modal`, `#dest-compare-modal`, `#trip-export-modal`, or `#poster-share-modal`.

asyncRacePatterns.issue: Rapid date changes in `#epic-date-input` fire uncancelled `fetchEpicFrames(selectedDateStr)` calls; no AbortController or request sequence guard prevents an older slower request from overwriting `framesCache` and `renderModal`.
`toggleDock()` awaits `syncLatestGibsDate()` without a re-entrancy lock; rapid double-clicks can toggle `isOpen` out of sync with `applyLayersToMap()`.

`ApiClient.fetchJson` supports external `AbortSignal`, but none of the domain services or UI panels pass an `AbortController` signal to cancel stale in-flight requests when switching destinations or closing modals.

docVsCodeDiscrepancies.claim: Multi-user real-time collaboration & D1 RBAC sync (`CollabSpace` + `worker/collab.js`)
docVsCodeDiscrepancies.reality: Backend `worker/collab.js` implements D1 RBAC routes, but frontend `js/lazy/collab-space.js` never calls `/api/collab/*` (only checks `useCloud` for a status badge) and its `BroadcastChannel("kairos_collab")` has no receiver anywhere.

docVsCodeDiscrepancies.claim: NASA GIBS "split-screen compare wipe" (分屏对比卷帘) & full trilingual support
docVsCodeDiscrepancies.reality: GIBS compare mode (`earth-timemachine.js:157-158`) only blends raster opacity (`1 - mix` vs `mix`), not a spatial split-screen slider, and the entire TimeMachine dock UI (L237-300) is hardcoded in Simplified Chinese (missing EN/zh-TW localization).

docVsCodeDiscrepancies.claim: Deep link restores spot, azimuth, date & locale; 6 poster ratios with local QR
docVsCodeDiscrepancies.reality: `js/app.js` ignores `cam`, `date`, and `layers` URL parameters; `ShareCenter` passes numeric `136` instead of `{size: 136}` to `QRCodeService.renderSvg`, lacks a change handler on `#sc-type-sel`, and passes ignored `bullets` to `PosterShare.renderPosterCanvas`.
`e2e/globe.spec.mjs:511-526` opens `ctxB` to `/?instant=1` and immediately closes it without performing any BroadcastChannel or collab action; it only checks `#topbar` button aria-labels on `page`.
Contains 18 PNGs (~20 MB): 9 `ChatGPT 图像 *.png` + 9 byte-identical `kairos-*.png` copies.
Local/cn `pages` branch (`84f2814`, 2026-11-27) still hosts V4.5.0 (`World Travel Globe`), whereas `.github/workflows/deploy-pages.yml` deploys `dist/` directly from `main`.

summaryOfCoverageGaps: Zero real-D1 / real-SQLite execution in tests (Worker Auth & Collab tests run against custom regex MockD1 objects).
Zero client-to-server integration tests for `AuthService`, `AccountCenter`, `CollabSpace`, `StorageDB` (real IndexedDB), or `sw.js` offline caching.
Worker Auth tests omit rate-limit lockout, logout, email verification, password reset, and profile update endpoints.
Worker Collab tests omit version restore, comments, polls/voting, shared expenses API, member role changes, and expired invites.

Zero E2E tests actually click Export formats, run offline pack caching, test `ShareCenter` QR/type changes, test `DestCompare` modal, test `TravelArchive` journal/EXIF upload, or test `BroadcastChannel` multi-tab convergence (Scenario 15 closes ctxB immediately).
